steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8069/ and sign in with login 'admin' and password 'admin'. Then in Odoo 17, create a new customer contact named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with the City field set to 'Benchville' (leave other fields as defaults; make sure it is saved as a customer/company type Individual if asked). Verify the record is saved by reopening it and report the Name and City values you see on the saved contact form. Note: the app long-polls so never wait for network idle — wait for concrete page state instead.

02-create: In Odoo 17 (already signed in as admin), go to the Sales app and create a new quotation. Set the Customer field to '{{runid}} Bench Customer' — this is an autocomplete dropdown, so you must type the name and actually pick the matching option from the dropdown that appears (not just type it). Then add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue using the product autocomplete dropdown (again, choose an option from the dropdown, don't just type), and set the quantity to 3. Let Odoo fill in the unit price automatically from the product's list price. Do NOT confirm the quotation yet — leave it as a draft quotation. Save the quotation and report: (a) the product name you chose, (b) the unit price Odoo filled in, (c) the Untaxed Amount the app computes, and (d) the quotation's reference/name (e.g. S00001). Note: the app long-polls so never wait for network idle — wait for concrete page state instead.

03-open: In Odoo 17 (already signed in as admin), open the existing draft quotation {{02-create.order_reference}} for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (go to Sales app, find quotation {{02-create.order_reference}} and open it). It currently has ONE order line: {{02-create.product_name}}, quantity 3, unit price {{02-create.unit_price_cell}}, Untaxed Amount {{02-create.untaxed_amount}}. Add a SECOND order line below it: pick a DIFFERENT product from the product catalogue using the product autocomplete dropdown (choose an option from the dropdown that appears, don't just type), and set its quantity to 2. Let Odoo fill in the unit price automatically. Keep the first line unchanged (quantity 3). Do NOT confirm the quotation — leave it as a draft. Save and report: (a) the second product's name, (b) its unit price, (c) the new Untaxed Amount the app computes for the whole quotation, and (d) the quotation reference. Note: the app long-polls so never wait for network idle — wait for concrete page state instead.

04-open: In Odoo 17 (already signed in as admin), open the existing draft quotation {{02-create.order_reference}} for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (Sales app, find quotation {{02-create.order_reference}} and open it). It has two order lines: line 1 is {{02-create.product_name}} with quantity {{03-open.line1_quantity}} (unit price {{02-create.unit_price_cell}}, subtotal {{02-create.untaxed_amount}}), line 2 is {{03-open.line2_product}} with quantity {{03-open.line2_quantity}} (unit price {{03-open.line2_unit_price}}, subtotal {{03-open.line2_subtotal}}), and the Untaxed Amount is {{03-open.untaxed_amount}}. Change ONLY the first line's quantity from 3 to 5 (leave line 2 and all prices unchanged). Let Odoo recompute the totals. Do NOT confirm the quotation — leave it as a draft. Save and report: (a) the new Untaxed Amount the app computes for the whole quotation, (b) line 1's new subtotal, and (c) the quotation reference. Note: the app long-polls so never wait for network idle — wait for concrete page state instead.
